src/app/sentinel/_py/__init__.py.name: Scoring server package
src/app/sentinel/_py/__init__.py.description: Marks the scoring server's folder as one package; it holds no code.

src/app/sentinel/_py/api.py.name: Scoring server
src/app/sentinel/_py/api.py.description: Receives every agent action, scores each agent every 2 seconds, serves the team's status, and carries out a person's quarantine, stop or release.

GET /health.name: Server check
GET /health.description: Replies that the server is up, whether it runs live or on the recording, and which scoring parts loaded.

POST /events.name: Report an action
POST /events.description: Where each agent reports every action it takes; feeds the next 2-second scoring round.

POST /score.name: Score one minute
POST /score.description: Scores one agent's one-minute summary and returns its risk, reason, partners and recommendation.

GET /agents.name: Team status
GET /agents.description: Returns every agent's risk, position, reason and status, patient zero, recent events and who messaged whom.

POST /decision.name: Record a decision
POST /decision.description: Records that a person approved or dismissed Sentinel's recommendation.

POST /agents/{agent_id}/action.name: Act on one agent
POST /agents/{agent_id}/action.description: Quarantines, stops, releases or dismisses one agent by writing the flag that agent obeys; only a person's click sends this.
